summary: This RFC explains how to use Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm keys and signatures in DNSSEC. It lists the curves to be used and specifies SHA-2 hashes for the signatures. Elliptic curves give strong signatures with smaller keys than older schemes.

eli5.summary: DNSSEC puts a tamper-proof seal on DNS answers. This RFC lets the seal be made with a newer kind of math that gives a strong seal using a smaller stamp.

questions: how to use ecdsa in dnssec
